requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.title: Sales manager creates an order with a valid request
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.
A valid order payload with one or more order lines is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders using the sales_manager credentials and the valid order payload.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted for processing.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The response has HTTP status 201 and response code CREATED.

test_cases.title: Order line accepts the minimum quantity boundary
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with an order line quantity of 1.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The request is not rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Order line accepts the maximum quantity boundary
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with an order line quantity of 100.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The request is not rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Order line rejects quantity below the minimum boundary
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with an order line quantity of 0.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The response has HTTP status 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Order line rejects quantity above the maximum boundary
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders with an order line quantity of 101.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The response has HTTP status 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Viewer is denied order creation
preconditions: A user authenticated with the viewer role is available.
A valid order payload with one or more order lines is available.

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/orders using the viewer credentials and the valid order payload.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The response has HTTP status 403 and response code FORBIDDEN.
